name: nearcab/call
title: NearCab Call (F1)
description: Stop 1: a big statement left, a washed card right (label, heading, lead, body) with the painted phone.

lead.default: The dispatcher has seconds to pick one.

body.default: The usual answer is a radio round: ask who is close, wait, guess. The wrong guess costs a cab driving empty across town and a caller watching the clock.
